newsitem.title: USA: Paulson group holds Multi-Market stake.
newsitem.headline: Paulson group holds Multi-Market stake.

text.p: A group including Paulson Partners L.P., a New York-based investment firm, said Wednesday it has purchased a 5.78 percent stake in Multi-Market Radio Inc.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its stake, totalling 205,500 common shares, includes a net of 204,380 shares purchased between June 21 and September 10 at prices ranging from $10.88 to $12.44 a share.
The group said it acquired the stake in the ordinary course of its investment business.
